description: Inventory, status, and health of AV devices across CERN rooms. Filter by room, category, or class; drill down to device/room details; track uptime, last seen, firmware, and alerts.

options.content: AV Devices

panels.description: This table lists every AV device in scope, showing its room, equipment class, category, vendor/model, status, last seen, firmware, error count, and basic uptime over the selected time range. Use the filters at the top (room, category, eqclass, status) to narrow the list before sorting by a column such as Status or Last seen. “Unknown” indicates an indeterminate state; “None” highlights missing metadata or missing telemetry, which is useful for data cleanup. Click a device name to open its detail view, where you can inspect recent heartbeats, error logs, and firmware information. For daily operations, triage by sorting Status to surface offline or degraded items first, then confirm that Last seen falls within your expectations for the device type. If a device appears repeatedly with “None” or very old “Last seen,” escalate for inventory/room mapping fixes or on-site checks.

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE
device_positions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.position
  FROM eam_devices d
  WHERE d.position IS NOT NULL
),
climb AS (
  SELECT
    dp.position          AS start_pos,
    p.equipmentno        AS cur_pos,
    p.parentasset        AS parent_pos,
    0                    AS depth,
    ARRAY[p.equipmentno] AS visited
  FROM device_positions dp
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno = dp.position
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    c.start_pos,
    p.equipmentno,
    p.parentasset,
    c.depth + 1,
    c.visited || p.equipmentno
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno = c.parent_pos
  WHERE c.parent_pos IS NOT NULL
    AND c.depth < 100
    AND NOT p.equipmentno = ANY (c.visited)
),
pos_to_room AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.start_pos)
    c.start_pos,
    c.cur_pos AS room_no,
    c.depth
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions rp ON rp.equipmentno = c.cur_pos
  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),
listed AS (
  SELECT
    room.equipmentno AS ConferenceRoomNo,
    CONCAT(parts.part1_txt, '/', parts.part2_txt, '-', parts.part3_txt) AS ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
    room.equipmentdesc AS ConferenceRoom,
    d.equipmentno      AS EquipmentNo,
    d.equipmentdesc    AS DeviceDesc,
    COALESCE(ld.manufacturer, d.manufacturer) AS Manufacturer,
    d.commissiondate   AS CommissionDate,
    d.assetstatus_display AS LeafStatus,
    d.eqclass          AS DeviceClass,
    d.category         AS DeviceCategory,
    CASE WHEN ld.equipmentno IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END AS Resources,
    parts.part1_txt, parts.part2_txt, parts.part3_txt
  FROM eam_devices d
  JOIN pos_to_room pr     ON pr.start_pos = d.position
  JOIN eam_positions room ON room.equipmentno = pr.room_no
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      split_part(split_part(room.equipmentno,'-',2),'.',1) AS part1_txt,
      split_part(split_part(room.equipmentno,'-',2),'.',2) AS part2_txt,
      split_part(split_part(room.equipmentno,'-',2),'.',3) AS part3_txt
  ) AS parts
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (equipmentno)
           equipmentno, manufacturer
    FROM landb_devices
    WHERE equipmentno = d.equipmentno
      AND (d.serialnumber IS NULL OR serialnumber = d.serialnumber)
    ORDER BY equipmentno
  ) ld ON true
  WHERE
    -- ROOM: All (__all) = no filter, else CSV list
    ( '${room:raw}' = '__all'
      OR room.equipmentno = ANY( STRING_TO_ARRAY('${room:csv}', ',') ) )
    -- EQCLASS: All (__all) = no filter, else CSV list
    AND (
      '${eqclass:raw}' = '__all'
      OR d.eqclass = ANY( STRING_TO_ARRAY('${eqclass:csv}', ',') )
    )
    -- STATUS: All (__all) = no filter, else CSV list
    AND (
      '${status:raw}' = '__all'
      OR d.assetstatus_display = ANY( STRING_TO_ARRAY('${status:csv}', ',') )
    )
    -- CATEGORY: All (__all) or None (__none__) = no filter, else CSV list
    AND (
      '${category:raw}' IN ('__all','__none__')
      OR d.category = ANY( STRING_TO_ARRAY('${category:csv}', ',') )
    )
)
SELECT
  ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
  ConferenceRoom,
  EquipmentNo,
  DeviceDesc,
  Manufacturer,
  CommissionDate,
  LeafStatus,
  DeviceClass,
  DeviceCategory,
  Resources,
  ConferenceRoomNo
FROM (
  SELECT *,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part1_txt,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS part1_num,
    regexp_replace(part1_txt,'^\d+','')                  AS part1_suf,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part2_txt,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS part2_num,
    regexp_replace(part2_txt,'^\d+','')                  AS part2_suf,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part3_txt,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS part3_num,
    regexp_replace(part3_txt,'^\d+','')                  AS part3_suf
  FROM listed
) s
ORDER BY
  part1_num NULLS LAST, part1_suf,
  part2_num NULLS LAST, part2_suf,
  part3_num NULLS LAST, part3_suf,
  ConferenceRoomNo,
  DeviceDesc;

SELECT
  LAST("status")   AS ping_status
FROM "ping_check" 
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY "equipmentno", "serialnumber"

SELECT
  LAST("status")   AS snmp_status
FROM "snmp_probe"
WHERE $timeFilter 
GROUP BY "equipmentno", "serialnumber"

WITH RECURSIVE
device_positions AS ( SELECT DISTINCT d.position FROM eam_devices d WHERE d.position IS NOT NULL ),
climb AS (
  SELECT dp.position AS start_pos, p.equipmentno AS cur_pos, p.parentasset AS parent_pos, 0 AS depth, ARRAY[p.equipmentno] AS visited
  FROM device_positions dp
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno = dp.position
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.start_pos, p.equipmentno, p.parentasset, c.depth + 1, c.visited || p.equipmentno
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno = c.parent_pos
  WHERE c.parent_pos IS NOT NULL AND c.depth < 100 AND NOT p.equipmentno = ANY (c.visited)
),
pos_to_room AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.start_pos) c.start_pos, c.cur_pos AS room_no, c.depth
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions rp ON rp.equipmentno = c.cur_pos
  WHERE rp.eqclass = 'AVR' AND rp.category IN ('AV-VCR','AV-VIS','AV-MRO')
  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),
rooms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT room.equipmentno AS room_no
  FROM pos_to_room pr
  JOIN eam_positions room ON room.equipmentno = pr.room_no
  -- ▼ Filter rooms by the selected status values (single, multi, or All= .*)
  AND room.assetstatus_display ~ '^(${status:regex})$'
),
fmt AS (
  SELECT room_no AS __value,
         CONCAT(
           split_part(split_part(room_no,'-',2),'.',1), '/',
           split_part(split_part(room_no,'-',2),'.',2), '-',
           split_part(split_part(room_no,'-',2),'.',3)
         ) AS __text,
         split_part(split_part(room_no,'-',2),'.',1) AS p1,
         split_part(split_part(room_no,'-',2),'.',2) AS p2,
         split_part(split_part(room_no,'-',2),'.',3) AS p3
  FROM rooms
)
SELECT __value, __text
FROM (
  SELECT *,
         NULLIF(regexp_replace(p1,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS p1n, regexp_replace(p1,'^\d+','') AS p1s,
         NULLIF(regexp_replace(p2,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS p2n, regexp_replace(p2,'^\d+','') AS p2s,
         NULLIF(regexp_replace(p3,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS p3n, regexp_replace(p3,'^\d+','') AS p3s
  FROM fmt
) q
ORDER BY p1n NULLS LAST, p1s, p2n NULLS LAST, p2s, p3n NULLS LAST, p3s, __value;
